summary: Integrated the existing append-only retry primitive with a bounded GitHub Contents host adapter. The adapter normalizes the observed GitHub 422 sha-not-supplied create collision into PATH_MAY_EXIST while preserving the mandatory exact-path reread before LOST_RACE, and normalizes branch/ref 409 into HEAD_MOVED so an absent deterministic path retries against the refreshed head without path variation. A dedicated Node CI canary runs both the original primitive suite and host-adapter integration suite successfully.
